info.title: SmsManager
info.description: Send SMS (and multi-channel) messages through the SmsManager API. Deliver transactional and promotional messages to one or more recipients worldwide with a single action.

api_key.name: x-api-key
api_key.description: SmsManager API key. Create one in your account settings at https://app.smsmanager.com/app/developers/apikeys.

post.description: Send a single message to one or more recipients (up to 10 recipients per request).

400.description: Bad request. The request body is invalid.

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing or invalid.

body.description: The text content of the message.
body.title: Message text

phone_number.description: Recipient's phone number in international E.164 format, including the leading '+' (for example +420777123456).
phone_number.title: Phone number

tag.description: Optional tag used to group messages (for example by campaign). Special tags: 'priority', 'transactional'.
tag.title: Tag

Callback.description: Delivery-receipt configuration. You fully define how SmsManager POSTs each delivery receipt to your endpoint (URL, method, headers and body template), so receipts arrive in exactly the shape your target platform expects - no middleware. Ideal target here is a Power Automate 'When a HTTP request is received' flow trigger.
Callback.title: Delivery receipt callback

url.description: Endpoint SmsManager POSTs each delivery receipt to. For Power Platform, use your Power Automate flow's HTTP request trigger URL.
url.title: Callback URL

method.description: HTTP method SmsManager uses when sending the receipt.
method.title: Method

content_type.description: Content type of the outgoing receipt request.
content_type.title: Content type

headers.description: Custom headers (up to 20) your platform requires, such as auth tokens or signatures.
headers.title: Headers

item.description: Per-recipient template. May be an object or an array.
item.title: Item template

body.description: Request body template SmsManager fills with receipt data and sends to the URL. May be an object or an array.
body.title: Body template

batch_size.description: Number of receipts SmsManager groups per callback request.
batch_size.title: Batch size

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each callback request.
timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)

accepted.description: Recipients that were accepted for delivery.
accepted.title: Accepted

key.description: Index of the recipient in the original 'to' array.
key.title: Key

message_id.description: Unique identifier of the accepted message.
message_id.title: Message ID

key.description: Index of the recipient in the original 'to' array.
key.title: Key
